settings.autoApproveHelp: Nobody is at the keyboard to approve a tool for a message from another app. With this on, approved senders can run any tool on this machine. With it off, risky tools wait for you here.

setup.discord: Click Connect and a Discord login window opens. Scan the QR with the Discord app on your phone, or log in with your email and password. AbacusAI Bot then messages as your own Discord account (no bot, no token). Or link the Abacus AI bot below and DM it from anywhere.
setup.telegram: Click Connect and a Telegram login window opens. Log in there the way you already do: scan the QR with your phone (Settings, Devices, Link Desktop Device), or use your phone number or a passkey. AbacusAI Bot then messages as your own Telegram account. No API keys, no bot.
setup.whatsapp: Enable this, then scan the QR code below from WhatsApp on your phone (Settings, Linked devices, Link a device). This links AbacusAI Bot as a device on that account, so use a dedicated number rather than your personal one.

messaging.telegramConnected: Connected. The agent reads your chats and messages other people as your Telegram account; messages to you arrive from your AbacusAI Bot.
messaging.telegramScan: A Telegram login window opened. Scan its QR with your phone (Settings, Devices, Add Device), or log in there by phone.
messaging.twoStepSetup: Two steps, and you need both: sign in to {{app}}, then link the Abacus AI bot so you can reach your agent from any device. Setup is not finished until both are done.
messaging.whatsappConnected: Connected. Message me from your “Message yourself” chat in WhatsApp. The agent also messages people as your account.
messaging.whatsappScan: Open WhatsApp → Linked devices → Link a device, then scan the code above. Once linked, message me from your “Message yourself” chat.
messaging.whatsappSyncing: Linked. WhatsApp is syncing your chats to this device. This takes a few minutes the first time. Keep WhatsApp open on your phone and keep this app open until it finishes.

referrals.defaultMessage:
I invite you to try the AbacusAI Bot, a free, open-source desktop AI agent.
Download it here (bot.abacus.ai): {{link}}

- 100% free: it runs on amazing free LLMs, no credit card, no subscription.
- Does real work on your computer: your files, terminal and browser, with your permission.
- Connects to Gmail, Google Drive, Slack, WhatsApp, Telegram and Discord.
- Runs bots and routines for you around the clock.

It is open source. If you like it, star the repo: https://github.com/abacusai/abacusai-bot
